items.stem: [Topic_Level_pyq_topic2] Cuboidal epithelium with brush border of microvilli is found in:
options: C) Proximal convoluted tubule of nephron
items.answer: C) Proximal convoluted tubule of nephron
items.explanation: PCT of nephron has simple cuboidal brush-bordered epithelium for selective reabsorption.

items.stem: [Topic_Level_pyq_topic2] The ciliated columnar epithelial cells in humans are known to occur in:
options: A) Eustachian tube and stomach lining
items.explanation: Ciliated columnar epithelium propels mucus in respiratory bronchioles and ova in Fallopian tubes.
